cues.text: The lighthouse keeper never sleeps before the storm arrives
He counts the waves and writes the number in a leather book
Nobody in the village has ever asked to read that book
Last winter the lamp failed for the first time in forty years
The keeper walked down to the harbour and borrowed a lantern
Since then he keeps two spare wicks in his coat pocket
A ship passed the point on the night the fog came inland
Its horn answered the bell three times before it turned away
